I started the cad for the case, I designed the front half of it, this part has a cutout for the screen to be seen through. I made sure to fillet all the edges so it looks nice and projessional. I downloaded a model of the screen to double check that it fits.

### 2026-10-30: I added support things to the back of the case, these allow it to be tipped back for more natural viewing and still stay standing, these were revolved from the back of the case, they should keep the d

**2h**

I added support things to the back of the case, these allow it to be tipped back for more natural viewing and still stay standing, these were revolved from the back of the case, they should keep the display stable when I tip it back, kind of like a phone stand.
